{
  "version": 1,
  "userSetting": "ComputerUseAllowForbiddenTargets",
  "openaiBundlePrefixes": [
    "com.openai."
  ],
  "keyInputMethods": [
    "pressKey",
    "typeText",
    "paste",
    "modifiers"
  ],
  "semanticWriteMethods": [
    "setValue",
    "selectText",
    "performSecondaryAction"

  "terminalSettingsTitlePattern": "^(?:general|profiles|window groups|encodings|advanced)$",

    "health",
    "getState",

    "getAXStateAndScreenshot"

  "pointerMethods": [
    "click",
    "doubleClick",
    "rightClick",
    "scroll",
    "drag"
  ],
  "agentHostBundlePrefixes": [
    "com.anthropic.claudefordesktop",
    "com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92"
  ],
  "categoryPriority": [
    "settings-windows",
    "password-managers",
    "authentication-agents",
    "protected-system-surfaces",
    "agent-hosts",
    "terminals"
  ],
  "exactIdentities": {
    "terminals": {
      "bundleIds": ["co.zeit.hyper", "net.kovidgoyal.kitty"],
      "helperBundlePrefixes": ["co.zeit.hyper.helper", "net.kovidgoyal.kitty.helper"],
      "executableNames": ["hyper", "kitty"]
    },
    "agent-hosts": {
      "bundleIds": ["com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92", "com.anthropic.claudefordesktop"],
      "executableNames": ["atlas", "cursor", "claude", "codex"]
    }
  },
  "identityShapes": {
    "password-managers": [
      "password",
      "keychain",
      "bitwarden",
      "dashlane",
      "lastpass",
      "keepass",
      "enpass",
      "protonpass"
    ],
    "terminals": [
      "terminal",
      "iterm",
      "ghostty",
      "warp",
      "wezterm",
      "alacritty",
      "tabby"
    ],
    "agent-hosts": [
      "chatgpt",
      "windsurf",
      "antigravity",
      "opencode",
      "t3code",
      "zcode"
    ]
  },
  "settingsWindowSubroles": [
    "AXSettingsWindow",
    "AXPreferencesWindow"
  ],
  "settingsIdentifierPattern": "settings|preferences|prefs",
  "settingsTitleWords": [
    "settings",
    "preferences",
    "réglages",
    "préférences",
